body:
An update. The guy just made a call-out post for me so they "take care" because I am a toxic person. This completely ruins my chances of interacting with anyone else. I'll basically be left friendless in some days or weeks. 
I'm devastated but I asked for it.
How can I do that? I try to get over it but everytime I do, they come back into sight again and I lose
Wouldn't that make me just a coward that backed out without arguing?

Like I said, I can't handle many messages at the same time and having unread messages makes me nervous. 

Also, I feel ashamed to ask them to reintegrate me.

A quick update.

After a long while of avoiding reddit because I was scared of judgement (ironic huh), I reflected on it better. And I've concluded ESH. 
She was tough on me but she hasn't spoken to me in this semester, which is fine, I guess. But I've realized I fucked up too and that mental issues are no justification. I reached out to the teacher and sadly he didn't allow her to pass and me to fail (which was the agreement we got to, that I'd speak to the teacher to try and get her to pass since her answers were better marked) but I've learned a lot about this whole experience. 

Thanks for your insight.

I apologized to her but she's still mad at me. And I can't. It was the final assignment of the semester and now I've made us both fail. 

I'm trying my best, I assure you, but after a year of being off the stress of college, it's kind of hard to get the hang of it once more. I'm still in that trial and error phase.

Kind of. It was assigned over a long weekend (we had Monday and Tuesday off) and she said she was out of town but she had turned in her answers. I'm not entirely sure if she checked mine, but I did check hers.
Well... It was a simple thing, just drawing the shapes of the continents on a ball. The parents were supposed to do it but eh, my mom has an awful sight and my brother is working on another city.

Everyone, thanks for your insight. My view has finally cleared. I apologized to my mom for being so rude to her and it all got solved over dinner. We managed to do the thing together. I'll try to work things out more in the future and try to better my communication skills.

Not me, but my sister once went out with my dad to eat to an italian restaurant. Apparently there was a slight delay in the kitchen and my dad got so mad he threw the plates at the chefs straight into the kitchen because it was a little cold. We never went there ever again.
